PREFATORY NOTE
This Index of Contributors lists the authors of entries
published in the Oxford Dictionary of NatioMl Biography in
September 2004, and shows which articles each wrote or
revised.
Entries in the Oxford DNB (2004) are either newly written
articles, or revisions of articles which appeared in the
Dictionat}' of National Biography (published between 1885
and 1900), or in its supplements (published between 1901
and 1996) or Missing Persons (1993). A contributor in this
index may therefore have:
written a new a1ticle in the Oxford DNB which
replaces one on a person included in the DNB;
written a new article on a person newly included in
the Oxford DNB;
revised for the Oxford DNB an article that originally
appeared in the DNB;
written a DNB ent1y that was revised for the Oxford
DNB by another contributor.
Articles are listed under the names of their contributors
without annotation if the articles were newly written for
the Oxford DNB. Articles are annotated '[rev.]' if the named
contributor revised that article for the Oxford DNB, and
'[orig.]' if they were contributed by that person originally
to the DNB between 1885 and 1996. In a few cases a DNB
entry was revised by its original author for the Oxford DNB;
these are shown without annotation.
The names of the subjects of articles are given in short­
ened form where necessa1y and may not incorporate all
details to be found in the full enny name at the head of the
article itself.
Contributors' names are indexed in the form in which
they are found at the foot of each article in the Oxford DNB.
Occasionally further explanat01y details are given in a
bracketed annotation: for example, 'Aberdare [fomth
Baron Aberdare]'.
The form of name used in the Oxford DNB is that chosen
by the contributor, wherever possible. The names of
authors who contributed only to the DNB are usually given
in the form that appeared there. However, in the early
volumes of the DNB articles were signed with initials. For
the Oxford DNB these initials have been converted to the
full name forms that were provided in the lists of contrib­
utors printed in each DNB volume. Some standardization
has been applied in such cases: for example, a single form
of name has been used for an author whose name was
given variously in the DNB. and multiple forenames have
been given as initials.
Contributors' names in this index are arranged in the
order used for entries in the Oxford DNB. People with
multiple surnames are usually entered under the final
element of their surnames.
If a contributor is the subject of an article in the Oxford
DNB a bracketed cross-reference gives the entry name
under which the contributor may be found in the diction­
ary: 'Abraham, E. P. [see Abraham, Sir Edward Penley (1913-
1999)]'.
For further information about the writing and editing
of the dictionary, see the 'Introduction' and 'Guide to
articles' in the first volume of the Oxford DNB.
Oxford, May 2004
